title: Citation
content: An AI citation is a source reference attached to an answer, and in this glossary a measurable web citation means a visible link to a source URL.

meta.why: The destination tells you which page was credited. The link alone does not show whether the answer represents that page accurately.
meta.example: An answer links to a shipping-policy page to support a claim about delivery times.
meta.check: Open the linked page, check that it supports the statement it is attached to, and record the source URL separately from brand mentions.
meta.limitation: Tools can count cited pages or cited domains differently. Document the unit before you compare totals.
meta.sources: Ahrefs: AI visibility metrics | https://help.ahrefs.com/en/articles/15501968-ai-visibility-metrics | Vendor documentation
